title: What Is AI?
status_note: Script written by Claude. NOT fact-checked against external sources (concept is general and not product-specific). Voice = Windows SAPI 'Microsoft Zira' (placeholder-quality TTS, offline). Visuals = programmatic drawings, not generated art.
prereq_note: Ep 2 (What is software? Rules vs learning) is not produced yet; this episode carries a short standalone bridge so it works on its own.
learning_objective: A viewer with no background can say what AI is: software that learns patterns from examples instead of only following rules a human wrote.
analogy: Teaching a toddler what a cat is by pointing at many cats.
analogy_breaks: A toddler understands cats; AI only finds statistical patterns and can be confidently wrong.
actual_tech: Machine-learning systems learn patterns from example data rather than being programmed with explicit rules for every case.
fact_check_notes: General concept only. Needs a human skim before publishing. No product claims made.
credit: Original storytelling by Zillenial Talk. No Anthropic material used.
takeaway: AI is software that learns patterns from examples.
cta: One tech concept. One simple story.

phrases.text: Hey techies! Sneha here from Zillenial Talk.
phrases.say: Hey techies! Sneha here from Zillennial Talk.

phrases.text: Nobody sat down and wrote a rule for how your email knows what's spam.
Think about teaching a toddler what a cat is.
You don't hand them a rulebook. You just point at cats, again and again.
Soon, they spot a cat they've never seen before.
That's the core idea behind AI.
phrases.say: That's the core idea behind A.I.

phrases.text: Instead of programmers writing every rule, the system learns patterns from lots of examples.
That's how spam filters, photo search and chatbots work.
Now, the toddler comparison has limits.
A toddler understands what a cat is. AI finds patterns in data, and it can be confidently wrong.
phrases.say: A toddler understands what a cat is. A.I. finds patterns in data, and it can be confidently wrong.

phrases.text: So AI is software that learns patterns from examples, not just rules a human wrote.
phrases.say: So A.I. is software that learns patterns from examples, not just rules a human wrote.

phrases.text: One tech concept. One simple story. I'm Sneha, and this is Zillenial Talk.
phrases.say: One tech concept. One simple story. I'm Sneha, and this is Zillennial Talk.
